name: Lunar South Pole region
description: Rugged highland terrain with permanently shadowed regions (PSRs) and near-continuous sunlight on some ridges; primary Artemis/CLPS focus area (Malapert, Mons Mouton, Nobile, Shackleton).

name: Mare Crisium
description: Basaltic mare basin on the eastern near side (>3 Ga), site of Blue Ghost Mission 1 near the volcanic cone Mons Latreille.

name: Gruithuisen Domes / Sinus Viscositatis
description: Silicic volcanic domes on the north-western near side; Peregrine Mission One's target bay lies just west of the domes.

name: Reiner Gamma (Oceanus Procellarum)
description: Bright albedo swirl associated with a crustal magnetic anomaly (mini-magnetosphere); IM-3 target.

name: Schrödinger Basin (far side)
description: Best-preserved peak-ring basin on the Moon, far side near the south pole; former Draper CP-12 target.

name: Lunar far side
description: Hemisphere never facing Earth; radio-quiet environment (LuSEE-Night) — requires relay satellites for communication.
